ocr.markdown:
Mix all of the filling mixture together thoroughly.
Divide the filling - Spread evenly over the tortillas
Roll up tortillas. Cover tightly with plastic wrap,
3 twisting ends; refrigerate for several hours.
Unwrap; cut in slices 1/2" to 3/4" wide.
Serve w/ salsa
